title: Understanding the Dimensions of Y
text: The vector $Y$ represents the dependent variable in the OLS regression. It contains the values of the variable you are trying to predict.

title: Relation Between X and Y
text: The design matrix $X$ has $m$ rows, each corresponding to an observation. The vector $Y$ should have the same number of rows as $X$ to match each observation.

title: Column Count of Y
text: Since $Y$ is a vector, it has only one column.

title: Determine the Dimensions of Y
text: Given that $Y$ is a vector with $m$ rows and $$1$$ column, what are its dimensions?
